data.title: 大凤 · 和风寝殿的红扇雅舞
data.description: 【大凤 · 和风寝殿的红扇雅舞】弥漫着沉香气息的重樱传统大寝殿内，朱红金漆屏风绘满了翔舞凤凰。大凤赤足踩在温润细密的草席上，金鱼华服下摆飞旋如浪。她双手执赤金绘扇优雅舒展身姿，漆黑长发与朱红长袖在空中曼妙缠绕，为心爱之人献上唯有主君方可得见的绝世神乐舞。
data.location: 重樱华美寝殿金箔屏风前
data.action: 手执双扇翩跹旋转起舞，振袖与及膝长发飞扬，赤足踩在榻榻米上
data.lighting: 宫灯烛台在金箔屏风上映照出流光溢彩的金红光晕
data.camera: full body, dynamic mid-dance angle, wide composition
data.promptProse: Taihou dances barefoot on the traditional chamber's tatami, opening red-and-gold painted fans in both hands as her red-black kimono sleeves and long twin tails turn around her. The full-body wide view leaves the phoenix-painted screen behind and clear floor under the movement. Palace lamps and candles reflect from gold leaf onto the fans and brocade, with layered sleeve shadows falling across the warm woven mat.
